title: Under-specified: parametric desk grommet
prompt: A cable grommet for the hole in my desk, the usual size. Parametric please.

hidden_tests.description: The model evaluates without feature or parameter errors
Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Common desk-hole sizes: Ø50–90 with the flange, 10–45 mm tall
At least two length parameters (e.g. hole diameter, desk thickness)

questions: What diameter is the hole in the desk (common: 60 or 80 mm)?
How thick is the desk top?
Do you want a cap with a cable slot?
clarify.assumptions: A 60 mm desk hole and an 18 mm desk top: Ø59.4 × 18 sleeve, Ø70 × 2 flange, Ø49.4 bore, no cap; hole diameter, desk thickness, flange overhang and wall are parameters.
